title: Augmented injective coresolutions detect Ext of cycles
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], let $T\in\mathcal A$, and fix an injective resolution [def-sp-injective-resolutions] $0\to T\xrightarrow{\varepsilon}I^0\to I^1\to\cdots$. Define the acyclic integer cochain complex $E(T)$ by $E(T)^0=T$, $E(T)^{k+1}=I^k$ for $k\geq0$, and $E(T)^k=0$ for $k<0$, with differential $\varepsilon$ in degree zero and the resolution differentials thereafter. Let $X$ be an acyclic integer cochain complex and assume $\operatorname{Ext}^1_{\mathcal A}(X^1,T)=0$, where $\operatorname{Ext}^1$ denotes short exact extension classes. Put $Z^nX=\ker d_X^n$. With $\operatorname{Hom}^r(X,E(T))=\prod_n\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(X^n,E(T)^{n+r})$ and differential $\delta h=d_Eh-(-1)^rhd_X$, there is a natural isomorphism
$$H^0\operatorname{Hom}^{\bullet}(X,E(T))\cong\operatorname{Ext}^1_{\mathcal A}(Z^2X,T).$$
For a cochain map $f:X\to E(T)$, the corresponding extension class is the pushout of $0\to Z^1X\to X^1\to Z^2X\to0$ along the unique map $Z^1X\to T$ through which $f^0:X^0\to T$ factors via $d_X^0:X^0\twoheadrightarrow Z^1X$.
